prompt: I’m going on a weekend trip to Germany and have limited space in my luggage. I’m choosing between taking with me either an umbrella or a waterproof jacket. Which one will me more useful to take with me?
response: A waterproof jacket is more useful for a weekend trip to Germany, as it provides additional protection from rain and wind. An umbrella is not necessary if you have a waterproof jacket, as it will suffice for most of your travel.
